svg.text: Cut 594 mm of 22 x 1.2 tube; deburr; fit end plugs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.5 mm holes square through the tube, 45 mm from each end, both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push a 110 mm rubber grip on from each end to 22 mm inside each hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (soapy water helps); the hands hold just inside the side tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: across the back of the flattened tops of the upper tubes, one M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt each through the flat and the grip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: grip level when the seeder stands on both wheels.
